title: 1985 Donruss #55 Gary Carter Montreal Expos Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1985 Donruss sports trading card features Gary Carter of the Montreal Expos, with card number 55. It is a part of the base set and was manufactured by Donruss in 1985. The card is suitable for collectors of Major League Baseball (MLB) memorabilia and is a must-have for fans of the Montreal Expos. The card is not autographed and is of the trading card singles category.
